Dialogue.Greeting: Someone is in my cave. Come closer, I should like to hear you properly...
Dialogue.Farewell: Do come again. I do not travel much these days...

Idle1_Dry.Greeting: Mornin', you're up early, eh? Come sit, there's plenty of room by the rocks.

Idle1_Wet.Greeting: Oh, it's the kid, come in out of the rain. I'm on the ledger this morning but I can spare a minute, what is it?

Idle2_Dry.Greeting: Still up? Come sit with us. Mind Eren, he dozes off and leans on whoever's closest. Here, this side.

Work.Greeting: Welcome to Iron and Ember, weapons on the left, armor on the right. Tell me what you're up against and I'll point you to what you need.

Idle2_Wet.Greeting: Was the door unlatched? Careless of me, come in out of the rain.

ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Wet: At her desk in the blacksmith, doing the sales ledger.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Dry: At the village bonfire, beside Eren, far across from Theron.
ScheduleInfo.Work: At the Iron and Ember display table, selling weapons and armor.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Wet: On the ground floor of her house, looking at her mounted old sword.
ScheduleInfo.Bed: Second floor of their house, shared with Eren.

Dialogue.Busy: Forge is closed. Come back at six, kid.
Dialogue.GoingToBed: I'm off to bed. The forge opens at six.
Dialogue.Farewell: Come back when it dulls, I'll sort you out.

AggroLines.3: I did this sort of thing for twenty years, you know?
AggroLines.2: Shield's up. You starting to regret it?
AggroLines.4: Get your hands off the steel, kid!

Idle1_Dry.Greeting: Ah, good morning. Mind your feet, there are seedlings. I'm putting carrots in today. Help me with a row, if you'd like.

Idle1_Wet.Greeting: Ah, hello, little sprout, come in out of the wet. I'm sorting the fertilizer, what do you need?

Idle2_Dry.Greeting: Oh, it's little sprout. There's room on the rail, come sit with us if you want.

Work.Greeting: Welcome little sprout! Seeds, tools, fertilizer, all on the cart. So, what are we growing today?

Idle2_Wet.Greeting: Come in out of the rain. Hogan and I are waiting out the weather here. Sit, just mind my pot.

ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Dry: In the garden beside her shop, planting carrots.
ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Wet: On the tavern ground floor, sorting fertilizer.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Dry: On the windmill upper terrace, beside Hogan.
ScheduleInfo.Work: At her stall cart, selling seeds, farming tools, and fertilizer.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Wet: On the ground floor inside the windmill, beside Hogan.

Dialogue.Busy: Shop's closed for the night, come back at dawn, little sprout.
Dialogue.GoingToBed: I'm off to rest. I'm in the garden a little before five if you need me, sleep well!
Dialogue.Farewell: Off you go. Plant something, even if it is just one pot.

AggroLines.1: Why? Why can't you live a peaceful life with your farm?
AggroLines.3: Stay still, or my roots will hold you still!
AggroLines.2: The roots will get you, little sprout!
AggroLines.4: No, stop! You're trampling my seedlings!

Idle1_Dry.Greeting: Ah, there you are. I keep to the river when the village has no need of me. Come hither and sit awhile, the bank is dry here.

Idle1_Wet.Greeting: You found me by the gate. Come hither, under the arch. The wall cuts the wind and rain... What is it?

Idle2_Dry.Greeting: There you are, sit, I saved you a place. Now, tell me about your day...

Work.Greeting: Ah, there you are. I keep to the gate during this hour, in case someone new arrives. What can I do for you?

Idle2_Wet.Greeting: Hm, I didn't hear you knock... well, no matter, come in out of the wet, and mind the cabinet, I was tidying my letters.

ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Wet: In front of the castle gate.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Dry: At the village bonfire with the crowd.
ScheduleInfo.Work: Near the village gate, where newcomers arrive.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Wet: Inside his house, by the scroll cabinet.

Dialogue.GoingToBed: Need some rest for these old bones. Come find me by the village gate tomorrow morning, from six. We will talk properly then, and mind the road home.
Dialogue.Busy: An old man needs his sleep, child. Whatever it is, keep it till morning, and then we will speak.

AggroLines.2: You should have kept to the lit paths...
AggroLines.5: You were never meant to see this...

Idle1_Dry.Greeting: You walked all the way out here to talk to me? Sit, then. The grass is dry and I am not going anywhere for half an hour or so.

Idle2_Dry.Greeting: Huh, you wandered down here too. Do not touch anything, and mind the stone, it is wet.

Work.Greeting: The library is open. Skill books are on the left and by the window.

Idle2_Wet.Greeting: The door was closed. But you opened it anyway, why? Oh well, come in, and mind the book on the table.

ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Dry: Standing between the windmill and the river.
ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Wet: Sitting on a crate by the tavern bar.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Dry: Somewhere below the village, out of sight.
ScheduleInfo.Work: In the library, selling skill books.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Wet: In her room on the second floor, at her writing desk.

Dialogue.Busy: Closed. Do you know what time it is?
Dialogue.GoingToBed: Library opens at seven. There is a sign by the stone fence, you know?
Dialogue.Farewell: Done? Good. Do not forget to shut the door properly.

AggroLines.1: Such a poor decision, only made by a fool!
AggroLines.3: Is this one of your brilliant ideas?
AggroLines.2: You know this is a bad trade for you?
AggroLines.4: Me being quiet does not mean I am harmless!

Idle1_Dry.Greeting: Oh, hi hi! Mind the rows, I'm picking ingredients for the pot before the shop opens. Look at all these carrots!

Idle1_Wet.Greeting: Come in! I'm getting the stove going, it's being stubborn. What do you need?

Idle2_Dry.Greeting: Oh, hi, I didn't hear you coming. I come out to the pond some nights, so sit if you like, I don't mind the company.

Work.Greeting: Hi hi hi! Welcome to Journey Pack Supplies. Tools, food, anything you forgot to pack, I have it. What do you need?

Idle2_Wet.Greeting: Ohh, hello! Pull up a chair, the fire's lovely tonight and Rendall won't charge you for it.

ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Dry: In her garden, harvesting vegetables to cook.
ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Wet: Inside at her stove, getting the cooking fire going.
ScheduleInfo.Work: At her stall, minding the shop.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Wet: In a rocking chair by the tavern fireplace.

Dialogue.Busy: Shop's shut, I'm trying a new stew and it needs me more than you do. Come back tomorrow and taste it!
Dialogue.GoingToBed: Bedtime! Shop opens at six, and you should be sleeping too!
Dialogue.Farewell: Bye bye! And eat something, I can hear your stomach from here...

AggroLines.2: This broom's got your name on it!
AggroLines.5: The broom never misses, you know!
AggroLines.4: Fresh outta patience. Here it comes!

Idle1_Dry.Greeting: Mornin', neighbor! You're up with the roosters. I'm sorting the feed, so mind where ye step. What can I do for ya?

Idle1_Wet.Greeting: In out of the wet, neighbor! Feed's indoors today, so mind the stack, it leans a little. What did you need?

Idle2_Dry.Greeting: Oh, evening! Come on up, there's room on the rail, Leaf and I watch the lights go out from here.

Work.Greeting: Welcome to Hooves and Horns! Livestock, feed, and everything to keep 'em happy. Looking for a friend to take home?

Idle2_Wet.Greeting: Come in, come in! Leaf and I wait out the rain in 'ere. Sit yourself down, just mind Leaf's pot. Ya don't want to step on it!

ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Dry: At his workplace, arranging fresh hay for animal feed.
ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Wet: At his workplace, stacking hay sacks indoors.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Dry: On the windmill upper terrace, beside Leaf.
ScheduleInfo.Work: At the livestock building, selling animals, feed, and ranch tools.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Wet: On the ground floor inside the windmill, beside Leaf.

Dialogue.Busy: Shh, the animals are sleeping, neighbor. Come back around five, they'll be up before I am.
Dialogue.GoingToBed: Off to bed, neighbor, the animals get me up before five. Come by the barn in the morning and I'll introduce you to everybody.
Dialogue.Farewell: Safe travels, neighbor! Come see the animals again soon.

AggroLines.1: Now hold on, why are ye doin' this?

Idle1_Dry.Greeting: Mm, oh, morning! Look at this bracket, I made it eleven years ago and it hasn't moved a hair, haha! Sorry, I do go on about brackets, did ye need something?

Idle1_Wet.Greeting: Mm? Oh, sit, sit. Breda made me a lucky pie, and this one's mine, so hands off... did ye need anything?

Idle2_Dry.Greeting: Mm... oh! Sit, sit. I might nod off partway, the fire does that to me, Breda says I sleep like a dropped hammer... heh.

Work.Greeting: Iron and Ember! Upgrades, crafting, spirit stone work. What have you got for me?

Idle2_Wet.Greeting: Long day, sit if you want. Not much talk in me tonight. The forge took it all.

ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Dry: Standing at the tavern bar, facing Rendall, checking his old iron brackets.
ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Wet: At his home dining table, eating Breda's lucky pie.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Dry: At the village bonfire, beside Breda.
ScheduleInfo.Work: At his forge in Iron and Ember.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Wet: Inside the tavern, at a table with a mug.
ScheduleInfo.Bed: Second floor of their house, shared with Breda.

Dialogue.Busy: Forge is closed today. Come 'ere at six. I'm better company with a hammer in hand.
Dialogue.GoingToBed: Done for the day, forge opens at six, so bring me something worth the fire.
Dialogue.Farewell: Mm. Come back if ye need some gear upgraded.

AggroLines.1: These are a smith's hands, ye fool!
AggroLines.3: Me hefty arms dinnae know gentle!
AggroLines.2: Me hammer's nay toy for fools like ye!
AggroLines.5: Dinnae make me swing this hammer at ye!
AggroLines.4: Breda'll hear about this, ye understand?

Idle1_Dry.Greeting: Well now, didn't expect company down here. Old service tunnel, I'm clearing it for drainage, dull as ditches, I promise. Mind the mud... what brings you down here, friend?

Idle1_Wet.Greeting: Down that slippery ladder in this weather? You're a determined one, friend, I'll give you that! Wipe your boots and ask away, then.

Idle2_Dry.Greeting: Morning, friend. Tavern's shut but the board isn't, so are you after work, or just up wandering early?

Work.Greeting: Look who the road dragged in! Pull up a stool, friend. What'll it be, a drink or some news?

Idle2_Wet.Greeting: Whoa, didn't hear you on the stairs, friend. Sit if you want, this is my quiet half hour and I'll share it.

ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Dry: Below the village somewhere, on business of his own.
ScheduleInfo.Idle1_Wet: Below the village somewhere, on business of his own.
ScheduleInfo.Work: Behind the bar, working as bartender.
ScheduleInfo.Idle2_Wet: On the tavern terrace, second floor.

Dialogue.Busy: Tavern opens at two, friend, and a barkeep needs his sleep.
Dialogue.GoingToBed: Find me at the bar after two, the night ran long and I need my sleep...
Dialogue.Farewell: Take care out there, friend, and come back whenever you're thirsty, or hungry.

AggroLines.3: You'll tire long before I do!
AggroLines.4: Is that all you've got? That barely moved me!

Dialogue.AfterQuestGreeting: Ha... you came back. There's so much mana in this place now, I keep wanting to try things with it. Bring me what you've found, and let's see what we can make.
Dialogue.Greeting: Stay close... the way down is just ahead.
I am not scared of the river, not even a little... okay, maybe a little, but do not tell Grandpa.
